Class InlineEffects

java.lang.Object
net.phoenix.chromatic_codes.api.InlineEffects
public final class InlineEffects extends Object
One-off effect definitions written directly in text, e.g. &[~FF0000,0000FF]Hello.

The definition is encoded into an effect identity's path and rebuilt on demand. These identities do not require separate font resources, so text retains its definition when copied without a resource reload.

Accepted forms (the text between the brackets, after the ~):

  • colors - static gradient, e.g. ~FF0000,0000FF or ~f00,00f or ~rainbow
  • movement - a movement id on its own, with defaults, e.g. ~size
  • movement:colors - e.g. ~wave:FF0000,00FF00
  • colorSpeed:moveSpeed:movement:colors - same order as the config gradient lists
  • animationSpeed:colorSpeed:moveSpeed:movement:colors - independent playback rate

Movement descriptors may append semicolon-separated options. Inline palettes and geometry have smaller budgets than programmatic definitions. Memoization stores successes and failures; factory publication clears these derived caches. Effects never require replacement font assets.

Choose a check according to the work it should perform:

  • isInlineName(String) and isInlineFont(ResourceLocation) only recognize the marker or identity family. They do not check whether inline definitions are enabled or whether the payload is valid.
  • fontFor(String) parses and validates a descriptor, or returns a cached identity. A cache miss can call the movement factory to check construction. isValid(String) uses this same path, so it can also create and cache an effect.
  • effectFor(ResourceLocation) returns the cached shared callback or rebuilds it from the identity. Both resolution paths check the current inline-enabled flag before returning a cached result.

An encoded identity stores settings, not a factory implementation. After a cache clear, rebuilding it uses the currently registered movement factory and can fail if that movement is unavailable or rejects the settings. Already returned callbacks remain the same objects; clearing caches does not reconfigure them.

  • Method Details

    • clearCaches

      public static void clearCaches()
      Discards both derived memoization caches; identities carry enough data to rebuild effects.

      This does not change definitions, factories or previously returned callback objects. Later resolution still requires inline admission and a factory that accepts the encoded settings. Movement factory publication calls this method automatically; ordinary definition publications do not clear these caches.

    • isEnabled

      public static boolean isEnabled()
      Reads current inline admission from the shared definition snapshot.
      Returns:
      true if inline parsing and encoded-identity resolution are admitted

    • isInlineName

      public static boolean isInlineName(String bracketContent)

      Returns:

    • isInlineFont

      public static boolean isInlineFont(net.minecraft.util.ResourceLocation font)
      Checks this mod's namespace and inline path prefix without decoding the payload.
      Parameters:
      font - candidate identity, or null

    • isValid

      public static boolean isValid(String bracketContent)
      Tests descriptor validation under the current inline admission policy.

      Delegates to fontFor(String). A cache miss can construct and cache an effect; use isInlineName(String) when only the leading-marker check is needed.

      Parameters:
      bracketContent - bracket content including its leading tilde, or null
      Returns:
      true when descriptor validation produces an identity; cached results may be reused

    • fontFor

      public static net.minecraft.util.ResourceLocation fontFor(String bracketContent)
      Parses or retrieves the self-contained identity for an inline token.

      On a cache miss, the candidate identity is decoded and its factory invoked before it is accepted. Saving the returned identity preserves the encoded settings, but does not keep a particular factory or callback object.

      Parameters:
      bracketContent - text between [ and ], including the leading ~
      Returns:
      the font id carrying the definition, or null if it isn't an inline code, is malformed, or inline codes are disabled in the config

    • effectFor

      public static IChromaticEffect effectFor(net.minecraft.util.ResourceLocation font)
      Resolves an encoded effect, rebuilding it when missing from the cache.

      Disabled inline definitions return null even for a cached identity. A rebuild uses the current movement factory; it can return a different object from an earlier lookup. Callers already holding the earlier callback may still use it directly. This method does not install a global formatting registration.

      Parameters:
      font - encoded identity, or null
      Returns:
      shared effect, or null for malformed, disabled or unrelated identities
